slug: 2026-02-09 Major SA data centre expansion plans emerge, set to more than double current power demand

facts.fact: Daily Maverick reports that Teraco's sustainability report gives a water usage effectiveness of 0.10 L/kWh for 2023 and total water use of more than 34,000 kl in the 2025 reporting period, 88% from municipal supply, and that Teraco says it uses closed-loop cooling.

Daily Maverick reports that African Data Centres signed a 12MW power purchase agreement for wind energy, wheeled to three of its South African data centres; the article gives no signing date, so the article's publication date of 2026-02-09 is used.
facts.system: Africa Data Centres 12MW wind power purchase agreement

systems.system: Cosmas Data City (Cape Town 360 MW, Kosmosdal/Samrand 200 MW)

note: Cavaleros planned campuses and Teraco's 120MW solar project under construction are not in service, so no fact; no PUE figure stated.
